note: Net revenue for an order = units * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct/100). 'Average order value' = mean net revenue per order.

questions.text: What is the total net revenue for Q2 2026 (orders dated 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 inclusive)? Give the answer in dollars.
Which region has the highest average order value (mean net revenue per order), and what is that average? Answer with the region name and the value in dollars.
Which product sold the most total units across all orders, and how many units? Answer with the product name and the unit count.
What percentage of all orders have a discount_pct of 20 or more? Answer with the percentage.
What is the total net revenue from Enterprise segment orders in March 2026? Give the answer in dollars.
